question: When is World Nature Conservation Day observed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**28th July**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Nature Conservation Day **is observed on **28 July every year**.
 
• The occasion aims t**o create awareness about the need to preserve the environment and natural resources** to maintain the balance of mother nature.
 
• Protecting endangered species is one the main objectives of **World Nature Conservation Day.**
 
• The theme of the world Nature Conservation Day 2021 was **"Forests and Livelihoods: Sustaining People and Planet"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1-July:** National Doctors’ Day, National CA day, GST day
 
• **2-July: ** World Sports Journalists Day
 
• **11-July:** World Population Day
 
• **17-July:** International Justice Day/Day of International Criminal Justice 
 
• **18-July: ** Nelson Mandela International Day
 
• **23-July:** National Broadcasting Day 
 
• **26-July: **Kargil Vijay Diwas 
 
• **28-July:** World Hepatitis Day
